design.act: fit one identical Zipf-Mandelbrot estimator to the Indus strict corpus, the named non-linguistic control systems, and the Linear B positive control, under gates and rules frozen before any fit, and append the outcome to the claim's record as a dated strength label

claim_under_test.normalised_claim: Indus script sign frequencies follow a Zipf-Mandelbrot distribution
claim_under_test.falsification_condition: If frequency distribution deviates from Zipf-Mandelbrot law
claim_under_test.posture: the claim stands on its recorded test; this spec appends a dated bounded finding (a strength label) and never re-adjudicates, edits, or supersedes the recorded status, exponent, or falsifier text

estimator_ruling.ruling: the freeze specifies the estimator of spec section 4.2 completely as a freeze-stage design decision; the identical-to-Phase-43 reading is RETIRED

phase43_evidence.finding: the file carries the Phase-43 corpus census and its positional and SA tables and records no Zipf fit: no exponent, no Mandelbrot parameters, no fitting procedure; the word Zipf does not occur in it; no Phase-43 Zipf estimator script is on main

estimator_ruling.recorded_value_posture: Yadav's recorded value of about 1.35 rests on the claim file's evidence string alone; this spec tests that recorded value under the named section 4.2 estimator, as context - it is not a reproduction target, and sensitivity S3 reports its fitted exponent beside the recorded value without adjudicating it
estimator_ruling.why_not_freeze_failure: the spec's falsifier never depended on a Phase-43 fit: it fires iff at least one named non-linguistic control fits as well as or better than the Indus strict corpus under this spec's one estimator (spec sections 1.2 and 4.3), a comparison internal to this spec; the central comparison is fully defined without the retired identity

estimator.normalisation: C fixed by normalisation: sum of fitted counts = N; C is not a free parameter
estimator.objective: minimise SSE = sum over ranks of (log f(r) - log f_hat(r))^2
estimator.refinement: one refinement pass at one-tenth steps in alpha and q around the best grid cell
estimator.ranking: types ranked by count descending; ties broken by type identifier ascending

self_test.procedure: counts drawn by the multinomial procedure stated in the execution script
self_test.pass: fitted alpha within 0.10 of 1.20 and fitted q within 1.0 of 2.0

comparison_rule.fits_as_well: a non-linguistic control fits as well iff its NRMSE_log is less than or equal to the Indus strict corpus's NRMSE_log
comparison_rule.synthetic_rule: N3's quantity is the median NRMSE_log across its 99 replicates; the replicates' full distribution and the share fitting as well are also reported
comparison_rule.near_miss: a control with gap in (0, 0.02] is named a NEAR MISS in every reporting product; the band is reporting-only and changes no verdict
comparison_rule.falsifier: the falsifier fires iff at least one of N1, N2, N3 fits as well under the rule above

controls.dd: DD-053-13 (named systems and sources confirmed at freeze; gate 0.4 is the fixed pin source for the control tables)
controls.pin_source: the step-0 record of gate 0.4: each system's canonical count table entered whole as cited data, with its source citation and per-count locators, frozen before any fit of any system

N1.source: Nissen, Damerow & Englund, Archaic Bookkeeping (1993) and the published archaic sign counts it reports
N1.unit: token frequencies of numerical signs only, from published counts of archaic Mesopotamian administrative tablets

N2.source: a published roll of arms, entered with its citation at gate 0.4
N2.unit: one charge occurrence on one shield, as the roll records it

N3.size_matching: run to exactly the Indus strict corpus's token total N (gate 0.5's count)

P1.source: published Linear B corpus counts, entered with its citation at gate 0.4

population.primary: the strict distribution: tokens in the step-0 pinned V3/Mahadevan-lineage corpus whose sign is in the strict sign set (the 94 strict_sa_independent anchors), counted by sign type; signs outside the strict set contribute neither types nor tokens
population.corpus_pin: no file pin is stated at the freeze, deliberately (the Spec 048 precedent): the layer is identified, exported in full, and pinned by SHA-256 digest at gate 0.3; failure closes the run as STRICT CORPUS NOT PINNABLE

positive_control_condition.rule: the comparison is informative iff E_P1 is strictly less than every non-linguistic control's error (E_P1 < E_N1, E_P1 < E_N2, E_P1 < E_N3)

sensitivities.S1: subsampling at inscription level (DD-053-9): random halves and quarters of the pinned corpus's inscriptions, 99 replicates per level, seed 20261021, sampling without replacement; median and central 90% interval of fitted alpha and NRMSE_log per level
sensitivities.S2: split/merge variants constructed from the pinned crosswalk alone (merged: allograph/variant-linked strict types collapsed, counts summed; split: composite strict types expanded where the pinned corpus's encoding carries the components; unexpanded types named and the variant labelled partial)
sensitivities.S3: the same estimator fitted to the pinned corpus's full sign inventory, reported with its fitted alpha beside the recorded exponent of about 1.35; the comparability bridge to Yadav's original population

design.fences: no outcome is evidence that the script encodes language, and none is evidence that it does not; the outcome is a strength label for a recorded curve fit and changes no verdict; three named systems are not all non-language; the strict fit's exponent is never quoted as Yadav's exponent reproduced or contradicted; arm B is not a member of this spec (campaign E-3)
design.execution_gate: Satisfied at the freeze of 2026-10-21 for the freeze act itself: execution runs as Phase-413 under the frozen contract only after the freeze has merged, the OSF registration's approval act has completed, and a separate execution order is given; no fit was computed at the freeze

claim_file.note: freeze-time hash carried as a definition constant in the Spec 038 form: the extracted-claims store is regenerated by the backend suite, so no freeze test asserts a live-file hash on it; the manual_001 facts are asserted on the live file instead
